macos.currentHost: Applied by the desktop Home Manager activation.
macos.Night Shift: Private CoreBrightness schema; configure in System Settings. The installer does not edit root-owned private preference files.
macos.application restarts: Preferences take effect on application restart or next login; activation does not kill applications.

linux.GNOME screenshot directory: Home Manager links Pictures/Screenshots to Desktop/screenshots for GNOME Shell's English folder name. Existing folders require conflict review and explicit migration. The gnome-screenshot application preference is retained.
